name: defs-unreferenced
description: dentro defs se ne va ciò che nessuno riferisce, tranne style; poi la defs vuota
input:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="usata"><stop offset="0"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="orfana"><stop offset="0"/></linearGradient>
    <style>rect { stroke: url(#dal-foglio) }</style>
  </defs>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="dal-foglio"/>
    <clipPath id="ritaglio"><rect width="5" height="5"/></clipPath>
  </defs>
  <defs>
    <!-- vuota dopo -->
    <filter id="ombra"/>
  </defs>
  <rect fill="url(#usata)" width="10" height="10"/>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="usata"><stop offset="0"/></linearGradient>
    <style>rect { stroke: url(#dal-foglio) }</style>
  </defs>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="dal-foglio"/>
  </defs>
